summary: Batch transcript image contract plays to avoid repeated per-commit browser bootstraps while retaining full merge coverage

schema.detail: No generated schema or wire-contract changes.

compatibility.detail: The commit lane exercises all image states, received-message carriers and keyboard lifecycles in one remounting contract play, plus the two existing thumbnail geometry widths. Individual state and phone plays remain in the full merge matrix. The time budget is unchanged.

recovery.detail: Revert the proof-selection change if required; runtime attachment behavior is unchanged.
